title: Giant wordmark gradient flood and pan
summary: The camera travels across an outlined wordmark taller than the frame while a sunrise gradient floods the letters, flips to dark letters cut out of the gradient field, then lands as a small gradient-filled wordmark on navy.
use_when: A brand intro where the colour gradient is part of the identity
A short vertical sting before or after a longer film
A name of 3 to 6 letters with bold, wide shapes
Silent autoplay feeds: no copy beyond the name

look.type_style: heavy condensed grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking; cap height ~75 % H in rows 1-2, ~22 % H in row 3, ~7 % H in row 4

sfx.event: hard cut to dark letters on the gradient field
small wordmark slides in to centre

structure.shot: wordmark taller than the frame drawn as a hairline outline on navy; first two letters pass, gradient starts filling from the bottom
structure.camera: dolly right across the word (content moves left), slow start then fast: ~0.15 W in 0.00-0.27, ~0.47 W in 0.27-0.50 (±0.25 s), easings.inOutSine
structure.motion: outline 1 px in the light gradient tint; dark indigo gradient rises inside the letter from 0.50, easings.inOutSine ~13 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the same giant letters now solid-filled with a moving gradient: indigo top, blue, lilac, cream bottom; outline gone
structure.camera: dolly continues ~45 px/fr at 1920 width (~0.7 W per s), easings.linear
structure.motion: gradient bands drift upward and tilt ~10 deg; cream reaches mid-letter by 1.50, easings.linear 26 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: figure-ground flip: full-frame gradient field, whole wordmark as dark navy letters across the middle, first letter at the left edge
structure.camera: dolly left-to-right reading ~28 px/fr at 1920 width, then push-in ~1.00 to 1.40 in the last 0.25 s into the cut, easings.inExpo
structure.motion: field opens dark and the gradient rises from the bottom over ~11 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outQuint; letters start near field colour and darken to navy by 2.00

structure.shot: small gradient-filled wordmark on flat navy, centred; holds to the end
structure.motion: wordmark slides in from the right edge to centre, easings.outExpo ~20 fr (±0.25 s), settled by 3.77; gradient inside sweeps from cream-left to blue-left over the same 20 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: display font (heavy), bg (deep navy), gradient stops taken from accent colours
params.content.name: the wordmark, 3-6 letters reads best
params.gradient.stops: 4-5 colours top to bottom, dark to light (default indigo, blue, lilac, cream)
params.pan.speed: px per frame at 1920 width for rows 1-2 (default 45)
params.timing.flipAt: frame of the figure-ground flip cut (default 49)
params.timing.landAt: frame of the cut to the small wordmark (default 92)
params.aspect: 9:16 native; 1:1 and 16:9 shrink the giant letters to 75 % H

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets and motion.json: rows 1-2 pan -706 to -1194 px/s at 1920 width, row 3 -852 px/s, row 4 zoom 2.75-2.87 %/s with coherence 1.0. The gradient is a soft multi-stop linear field that drifts, closest vocabulary look id mesh-gradient. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): outline-fill, figure-ground-flip. No end-card: the close has no URL or CTA, only the mark for ~1.46 s. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
